messages:
ella_sales: Quick thread— HelixCare wants a POC with dedicated GPUs for demo hours only. They're proposing a 12mo commit (~$550k). Need uplift estimate and approval flow.
nick_se: They request 12 GPUs reserved 10:00-16:00 US‑EST Mon-Fri, autoscale within the pool allowed to 16 for bursts. Off-hours can be preemptible.
sam_dealdesk: Clarify region (us-east-1?) and whether they accept scheduled maintenance (we normally allow up to 4h/qtr). Also: do they want flat reserved billing or metered burst above 12?
ravi_finance: For a 12mo $550k commit in us-east, non-preemptible carveout uplift typically 14-18%. If they allow metered burst we can target 13% uplift; flat reserved burst to 16 GPUs pushes toward 17-18%. With firm monthly profiles we can offer 12% as a concession.
anya_ops: Ops: we can provision 12 dedicated non-preemptible GPUs in us-east; lead time ~6 business days. Autoscale inside the dedicated pool to 16 is fine but requires quota config. Need infra ticket with manifest.
contracts_bot: Suggested clause: "Provider will allocate dedicated non-preemptible GPU capacity for agreed demo windows. Scheduled maintenance (<=4 hours/quarter) is excluded. Failure to meet guaranteed availability results in service credits per SLA."
sam_dealdesk: Approval thresholds: uplift <=14% = deal desk approval; 15-18% = finance + CRO approval; >18% = exec review. Action items: (1) @ella confirm region and billing preference by EOD; (2) @nick open infra ticket with pool spec; (3) @ravi publish uplift memo for sign-off.
ella_sales: Will confirm with customer and return w/ final numbers today. :white_check_mark:
